lines.trans: What a nightmare! A real Othello in the kitchen!
Drag your bird to the sous-chef's table!
Lyova, start preparing the goose quickly!
Understood, Chef, I am turning on the oven.
And I will take care of an important compliment.
I saved the bird and my job.
Bye!

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order
the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

examples.text: Я тебе утром говорил: не торопись. Это очень важный вопрос.
examples.trans: I told you this morning: don't rush. It's a very important question.

включать.gloss: to turn on, to switch on

meanings.en: to turn on, to switch on

examples.text: Нельзя вместе включать обогреватель и чайник.
examples.trans: You can't turn on the heater and the kettle together.

examples.text: Я тебе сто раз говорил! Нельзя вместе включать обогреватель и чайник.
examples.trans: I've told you a hundred times! You can't turn on the heater and the kettle together.

examples.text: А где машинка? Где моя машинка?
examples.trans: Hey, where's the toy car? Where's my toy car?

examples.text: Я уже не могу готовить, стирать, убирать. Я хочу на море!
examples.trans: I can't take the cooking, washing and cleaning any more. I want to go to the sea!

meanings.note: a large waterbird with a long neck and webbed feet

examples.trans: Chef, this is a live goose!

examples.text: Зачем нам живой гусь на кухне?
examples.trans: Why do we need a live goose in the kitchen?
Can you believe it, they forgot it in the oven!
The pie is in the oven.

examples.text: Представляешь, в духовке забыли! Юль, выйди.
examples.trans: Can you believe it, they forgot it in the oven! Yul, step out.

задушить.gloss: to choke, to strangle, to suffocate

meanings.en: to choke, to strangle, to throttle

examples.trans: This collar is going to choke me.

заняться.gloss: to attend to, take care of, engage in

meanings.en: to attend to, occupy oneself with
meanings.note: + instrumental: заняться деньгами = to take care of the money

examples.trans: I will take care of this question tomorrow.
And I will take care of an important compliment.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Как вы знаете = as you know.

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

examples.text: На столе не осталось ни одной капли воды.
examples.trans: Not a single drop of water remained on the table.

examples.text: На тебе нет ни капли крови!
examples.trans: There is not a drop of blood on you!

meanings.en: complimentary gift from the house (in restaurants/services)

examples.text: Это небольшой комплимент от нашего заведения.
examples.trans: This is a small gift from our establishment.
He paid her a nice compliment.
And I will take care of an important compliment.

meanings.note: colloquial: Это кошмар! = That's awful / a nightmare!

examples.trans: That's a nightmare, I don't argue.

examples.text: Это кошмар, я не спорю. Но зачем на видео снимать?
examples.trans: That's a nightmare, I don't argue. But why film it on video?
What is this? Is this blood?
Look how much blood came out!

meanings.note: в кухне / на кухне = in the kitchen, на кухню = to the kitchen
E.g. русская кухня. Entered Russian via Polish 'kuchnia' and Middle High German 'küchen', ultimately from Late Latin 'coquina' (from 'coquere', to cook).

examples.trans: And the kitchen is over there.
We are sitting in the kitchen.

examples.text: Проходите, пожалуйста! Как видите, большой коридор, а там кухня.
examples.trans: Come on in, please! As you can see, a big hall, and the kitchen is over there.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

examples.text: Ваня, да пойми ты наконец! Это настоящий успех.
examples.trans: Vanya, understand at last! This is real success.

examples.text: Аркаш, ну что скажешь? Когда начинать?
examples.trans: Arkasha, so what do you say? When do I start?

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
+ genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice
+ genitive: ни копейки = not a penny

examples.text: Пятьсот. А у меня ни копейки.
examples.trans: Five hundred. And I haven't got a penny.

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.trans: The cook was behaving very suspiciously.
Why are you so suspiciously clean?

examples.text: Это звучит очень странно и подозрительно.
examples.trans: That sounds very strange and suspicious.

meanings.note: Понял? = got it?; понял = got it.

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?
Why are we going so slowly?

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

прикончить.gloss: to finish off, to kill, to bump off

examples.text: Повар наконец прикончил всю сложную работу.
examples.trans: The cook finally finished off all the hard work.
I have just finished it off!

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

meanings.note: a warm-blooded egg-laying vertebrate with feathers

examples.trans: Birds have a very weak heart.

examples.text: Что нужно сделать с этой птицей?
examples.trans: What needs to be done with this bird?

meanings.en: to cut, to slice, to carve

examples.trans: Cutting a living person with a knife!

examples.text: Нина, ну как ты могла? Живого человека ножом резать!
examples.trans: Nina, how could you? Cutting a living person with a knife!

examples.text: Свежие ягоды, кофе! У вас тут романтический завтрак.
examples.trans: Fresh berries, coffee! You are having a romantic breakfast here.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

examples.text: Я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: That's not what I mean at all.

examples.text: Нет, Вика, я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: No, Vika, that's not what I mean at all.

examples.text: Эдуард Владимирович, я на минуточку. Я спасла монастырь!
examples.trans: Eduard Vladimirovich, I'll only be a minute. I saved the monastery!
We will sit together in a friendly way at the table.

examples.text: Не бойся, всё в порядке! Посидим дружно за столом.
examples.trans: Don't be afraid, everything is fine! We will sit together in a friendly way at the table.
Take your feet off the table quickly!
Are you a sous-chef or who?

examples.text: Тащи свою птицу су-шефу на стол!
examples.trans: Drag your bird to the sous-chef's table!

meanings.note: 'что я за мэр такой' = what kind of mayor am I

тащить.gloss: to drag, to pull, to carry, to bring

examples.trans: Then run, go grab a clothespin quickly!

examples.text: Тащи свою птицу су-шефу на стол!
examples.trans: Drag your bird to the sous-chef's table!

meanings.note: softens a request: только не сердись = just don't be angry

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: 'mum will kill me' = I'll be in big trouble

examples.trans: Do you want to kill me?

examples.text: Ты смотришь на меня так, как будто убить хочешь.
examples.trans: You look at me as if you want to kill me.

meanings.note: short form чисто: всё чисто = everything is clean

examples.text: Нин, я всё помыл. Всё чисто.
examples.trans: Nina, I washed everything. It's all clean.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: Informal. Borrowed from French 'chef' (head, leader, from Latin 'caput'); in Russian kitchen culture 'шеф' is the standard form of address for the executive head chef.

examples.trans: The chef is in the kitchen.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
